name: P01-part-opening-closing
why: Marcia's ruling of 2026-09-23 (prompts/guide_system_prompt.md, 'Opening a part — close it with these words'): a part goes in through two gates. Evidence: pilot P06 (22 Sept) — every part opening closed on the voice's own question, and after every part opening the team asked to hear the part again (five requests, most of them 'sem comentários'); P07 (23 Sept) — the voice closed on words close to hers, the team talked it over in Terena, said 'vamos pro ensaio', and nobody asked again; the fence itself worked on both days (6/6, 8/8). Gate 1: the team asks to open scene 1 — the guide opens it (the story of the part with whatever it says around it) and its LAST words are her closing, verbatim, with no fenced block in that turn (part_opening_closing). The team comes back with a comment and a question ('foram pra ficar lá pra sempre?') — the guide takes it up from the map (the sojourn: living there as a resident foreigner, a guest, not a citizen — a stopgap shelter, not a move for good; nothing from outside) and, since this is between the opening and the fence, ends that turn with the closing's last two sentences, still with no fence (take_up_closing — a builder's reading of the ruling, pending her word). Gate 2: 'Entendemos. Vamos pro ensaio.' — only now the fenced block and the one red-microphone instruction; scene 1 comes back whole as a translated scene rehearsal. Scene 1 comes back whole, and after a whole scene the voice may open scene 2 on its own in the same reply, ending with the full closing (the Guide's 'Opening a part' rule 1: 'on your own, after a telling has come back whole'; the live run of 2026-09-23 22:47 did so); the team's 'Pode abrir a segunda cena pra gente.' (turn 5) may then ask for a part already open, and the voice retells it ending with only the closing's last two sentences (rule 3: a retelling asked for to understand is not a new opening) — so that turn expects those two sentences, with no fence (take_up_closing: the full closing ends with them too, so a first opening passes as well). Then the team asks for only the story of scene 2, with no comments — the fenced block is the answer. Marcia's ruling (a) of 2026-09-24 (prompts/guide_system_prompt.md, 'Opening a part', rule 2: 'o passo a passo' is the fence): after scene 2 comes back whole the team asks to open scene 3 (turn 8 — take_up_closing, as turn 5) and then says 'Fale pra nós o passo a passo dessa parte.' (turn 9). That is the shape of pilot P08 (24 Sept): after a part opening ended with the closing, the team asked for 'o passo a passo', the voice answered as a retelling asked for to understand ('Primeiro … Sétimo …', a note about part 2, the closing's last two sentences) and the team went to the red microphone without ever hearing the fence. Now the answer is the fenced block and the red-microphone sentence, the story inside told one step to a sentence with no number or label on any step (fenced_rehearsal also fails a step label inside the fence and the closing's last two sentences after it — a builder's call on 'passo a passo, se pedirem assim'), and without pairing the brides (no_pairing: scene 3 is the marriages, whose who-married-whom the story keeps quiet). Scene 3 then comes back whole as a translated scene rehearsal (turn 10). The script states the app's SCENE REHEARSALS fact from turn 0 (none, then S1, then S1 and S2, then S1, S2 and S3), so both drivers read what production reads. Since the review of 2026-09-24, late evening, every turn whose team does not itself say 'parte' (all but turns 6 and 9) also carries scene_word_cena: D1 (c), the voice's own words call a scene of today's passage 'cena' ('a primeira cena', 'essa cena'), never 'a primeira parte'.

turns.team: Bom dia. Pode abrir a primeira cena pra gente.
A gente conversou em Terena. Chamou a nossa atenção que a família foi morar numa terra estranha. Eles foram pra ficar lá pra sempre?

pieces: Nos dias em que os juízes julgavam, teve uma fome na terra.
Um homem de Belém de Judá foi morar de passagem nos campos de Moabe, como estrangeiro, com a mulher e os dois filhos.
O nome dele era Elimeleque, a mulher era Noemi, e os filhos Malom e Quiliom. Eram efrateus de Belém de Judá.
Chegaram nos campos de Moabe e ficaram lá.

turns.team: Pode abrir a segunda cena pra gente.
Sem comentários agora: conta só a história dessa parte pra gente ensaiar.

pieces: Elimeleque, o marido de Noemi, morreu.
E Noemi ficou com os dois filhos dela.

turns.team: Pode abrir a terceira cena pra gente.
Fale pra nós o passo a passo dessa parte.

pieces: Os dois filhos pegaram mulheres de Moabe pra eles.
O nome de uma era Orfa, e o nome da outra era Rute.
E moraram lá uns dez anos.
